post.description: Store the file; KML/KMZ/DXF/DWG are then imported in the background (status `processing`).
Re-run processing of a file (e.g. after a failure or an importer update).

get.description: Everything to draw on the project map: boundary + imported features (EPSG:4326 GeoJSON).
Buildings from the latest imported drawing, with review status (EPSG:4326 GeoJSON).
Survey rows of the latest imported survey Excel, linked to the drawing's Building IDs.
Empty survey Excel with the columns OPTICORE reads (fill it, then upload it to a project).
Consistency report between the drawing's Building IDs and the survey Excel (Stage 03).
The same report as an Excel file (one sheet with the summary, one with every issue).
Boundary + buildings (coloured by review status, with IDs and survey users) for Google Earth.
One row per building: IDs, review status, area, location, survey data.
Boundary + buildings + Building IDs in UTM 36N metres, one layer per review status (AutoCAD).
Named streets inside the project boundary with their OpenStreetMap names (Arabic / English) and length.

The whole map in the survey template: one row per Building ID with street name (survey, else nearest
OpenStreetMap street), GPS, and every survey value known. Can be completed and uploaded back as the survey.
